title: TMG-2 re-open and conformity rule for Route-C V9F mass, center of mass and inertia

trigger_source.qualitative_trigger: Route-C changes system mass/CG/inertia beyond current uncertainty envelope
trigger_source.limitation: ODR-50 does not define a numerical comparison metric, coverage factor, guard band, conformity limit or decision-risk policy.

diagnostic_only_not_acceptance.warning: These dimensionless ratios are screening diagnostics only. Standard uncertainty is not a tolerance or conformity limit.

candidate_results.uncertainty_boundary: Baseline-to-Route-C cross-covariance and a coupled measurement model are unavailable; no combined updated-system uncertainty or formal conformity statement is issued.

owner_decisions_required: Authorize or decline formal TMG-2 reopening for V9F.
Resolve or explicitly disposition the frozen configuration authority states C05=FAIL and C06-C09=HOLD; numerical mass-property consistency does not override them.
Define whether ODR-50 compares absolute change, standard uncertainty, expanded uncertainty, a mass/CG/inertia requirement envelope, or an integrated dynamics sensitivity limit.
Define the coverage factor, guard band and false-accept/false-reject risk policy.
Define numerical limits for mass, each CG component and all six independent inertia components about one frozen reference point and frame.
Confirm the nine configuration set and whether captured-target configurations C08/C09 are evaluated as combined-system cases or excluded from service-spacecraft conformity.
Define the disposition when the mass criterion passes but any CG or inertia criterion fails.
Define whether a TMG-2 failure returns to bounded mass-property optimization, blocks Route-C integration, or requires a higher-level system waiver.
engineering_recommendation_non_authorizi: REOPEN_TMG2_FOR_INTEGRATED_REASSESSMENT only after explicit disposition of C05-C09 binding authority because V9F adds 3.040266861665941 kg and the diagnostic CG/inertia shifts exceed one baseline standard uncertainty in multiple service-spacecraft configurations; do not infer acceptance from this recommendation.
forbidden_inferences: standard uncertainty equals an acceptance limit
mission-only Route-C geometry evidence authorizes downstream rebind
captured-target mass can be silently removed from or added to a configuration
